simple.meaning: בַּצֹּרֶת (batstsôreth) is a Hebrew action word meaning “restraint (of rain), i.e. drought.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 2 times in Jeremiah, beginning at Jeremiah 14:1. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to בַּצֹּרֶת (H1226) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: בַּצֹּרֶת (batstsôreth) / H1226 is traced through Jeremiah 14:1, Jeremiah 17:8 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.full: H1226. batstsoreth בַּצֹּרֶת noun feminine dearth (compare following), בּ ׳שְׁנַת Jer 17:8 . בַּצָּרָה noun feminine dearth, destitution (i.e. diminution , compare PS 572 ; see also verb ᵑ7 בצר Prov 14:28 people reduced ) — dearth (= בצרת ) בּ ׳עִתּוֺת Psa 9:10 ; 10:1 ; plural בַּצָּרוֺת Jer 14:1 .
